assets.prompt: Create ONE original exquisite traditional Chinese gongbi painting of Mazu (天上聖母), NOT a statue, NOT a photograph, NOT a 3D render. Full seated figure, front-facing symmetrical composition, dignified benevolent adult feminine face with calm clear eyes. No lotus, no vase, no halberd, no beard, no other deity. The robe cascades into precise flowing folds, feet discreetly covered, small understated antique chair mostly behind the robe. Exact composition for later registered painting stages: crown from x30%-70%, y10%-25%; face centered x50%, y29%-37%; tablet at x50%, y45%-61%; robe spreads x21%-79%, y39%-88%. Flat hand-painted surface with exquisite tangible pigment detail, respectful and serene, elegant restrained palette. This must look like a finished painting on silk, not a digitally rendered character. No lettering, calligraphy, signatures, stamps, watermarks or logos. One single full composition, no collage, no decorative border.
